crossRefs.note: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over…
However I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel);
translations.bsb: But one tribe will remain for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
